paras: Brachymeles bicolor, common name two-colored short-legged skink, is a species of skink endemic to  Luzon, the Philippines. It is widely distributed through the island, at elevations of 250 to 850 m above sea level. However, its population is declining due to deforestation, and hence the species is classified as least concern by the IUCN.
